_comment: vault.c gd_move() draws rn2(10) for "Move along!" whenever the guard is not next to a hero who has not followed it. The port's dry run of a turn used to skip gd_move() entirely, so its random draws fell behind the live game's after the guard's first move, and for a burdened hero its count of movement allocations could disagree with the live count ("elapsed-turn preflight disagreed with live allocation count"). The dry run now stops at gd_move() and the live pass plans the rest of the turn after that scan. A debug-mode Monk (intrinsically Fast) teleports into a level-1 vault, wishes for a heavy iron ball, polymorphs into a gnome (Strained), answers the guard and keeps searching while the guard calls "Move along!". Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples and of strained-gnome-guard-question-midturn.
